sv.title: Fed-topp: Räntan bör fortsätta att höjas i mindre steg
sv.summary: Federal Reserve bör fortsätta höja räntan i mindre steg trots ett tilltagande inflationstryck. Det sade Beth Hammack, Fed-chefen i Cleveland, i en intervju med Bloomberg tv på måndagen.

en.title: Fed top official: Rates should keep rising in smaller steps
en.summary: The Federal Reserve should continue raising rates in smaller steps despite mounting inflationary pressure. Beth Hammack, president of the Cleveland Fed, said this in an interview with Bloomberg TV on Monday.
